markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
MUSK model, conformal set and 5/5 neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% | Near-certain |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 94th percentile | Reliable; OOD percentile high |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · low score; scarce tubules associate with invasive · Validated
- **Benign stroma or fat** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · low score; little benign tissue · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 3, 9) · ↑ invasive · high score in these regions · Validated
- **Nuclear size variation** (regions 2, 5, 7) · context · 98th percentile of reference; sampled regions only · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007): not shown to reflect classifier. Unreliable here: normal lobules, mitoses, necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated frozen section; calibration error 5% (CI 3–18%) rests on only 132 test images.
- Reliability score ranks errors modestly (AUROC 0.69), so high reliability reassures little.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 5**: confirm scarce glands and little benign stroma.
2. **Regions 0, 3, 9**: verify marked nuclear pleomorphism.
3. **Edge regions 0–4, 7–11**: confirm suggested tumor at all four margins [F10].
